quotes ‘Pansies let my flowers be’, specifying the pansy as ‘his flower’ which she intends to have
engraved on a locket to wear in S.’s memory. So not quite three weeks after S.’s death, Mary must
have seen either the ink revisions in Nbk 22 or Princeton or both, though it is always possi-
